lines.en: I drift slowly through the air.
My arms hang, dripping fire.
I glide along the lava's surface.

lines.zh: 我从一群同伴旁边游过。
lines.en: I drift past a flock of my kin.
I cross a lake of fire.

lines.zh: 我不必落地，也从不着陆。
lines.en: I need not land, and never do.
My body sways in the heat.
I circle a block of lava.
I drift over with my arms trailing.
Smoke rises from all of me.
I float up half a block.
I ride the rising heat.
I drift crookedly, unsteady.

lines.zh: 我经过石柱时缩了一下。
lines.en: I shrink slightly passing a pillar.
I come your way bit by bit.
I patrol this stretch slowly.
My arms sway behind me.
I hang like a fire that will not disperse.
My arms twitch gently.
I soak in the heat waves.
I stay still; the flames dance on their own。
My eyes are bright and round.
I draw my arms in slowly.
I wait for someone to strike first.
I crowd in with my kin.
My body swells once in a while.
I listen to the lava flow.
I coil one arm.
I float one block above the lava.
I make no sound but the sizzle.

lines.zh: 我在热里慢慢转了个向。
lines.en: I turn slowly in the heat.
I lift one eye to you.

lines.zh: 我的触手朝你伸了一点。
lines.en: My arms reach a little toward you.
Your coolness stands out.
I tilt, as if undecided.

lines.zh: 我的火苗在你面前矮了。
lines.en: My flames dip before you.
I turn to you slowly.
Only two blocks between us.
I float on the lava, watching you.
I hiss and crackle.
I shrink and my flames dip.

lines.zh: 我有几条触手卷起来了。
lines.en: A few of my arms curl up.
I drift half a block crooked.
I give a crackling cry.
A small piece of me is gone.
I retreat over the lava.
I shake and the fire flares again.
I slowly pull my arms in.
My eyes narrow.
I stare at you and my fire grows.
I glance and drift away.
In the fire there is no need to eat.
I circle all the way around it.
I scorch it.
I touch it with an arm.
Uninterested, I move on.
I like setting fire better.
I push it back to you.
I shake and drift higher.
My arms scatter and gather.
A wave of heat clings to you.
I am nudged half a block.
The spot you touched burns.
My kin all turn their heads.
I wobble beside you.

lines.zh: 水汽从我们之间冒出来。
lines.en: Steam rises between us.
You did not push me far.
I slide past you, very hot.

lines.zh: 我的触手扫开你，又收回来。
lines.en: My arm sweeps you aside and returns.

lines.zh: 两只熔岩鱿鱼并排浮着。
lines.en: Two lava squids float side by side.
Our arms tangle once.
We rise upward together.
It touches my arm tip.
Our flames blend into one.

lines.zh: 我们一起绕着一根柱子。
lines.en: We circle a pillar together.
Neither of us will ever touch down.
Our bodies lie close.

lines.zh: 我们一起吐出一小团火。
lines.en: We spit a small flame together.

lines.zh: 我们一起沉到熔岩边上。
lines.en: We settle down by the lava together.
I lift it and it glows red.
Smoke rises from it in my arms.
I float a short way with it.
I hide it under my arms.
I curl around it and let go.
It drops and hits the stone.
I carry it upward.
It softens in the heat.
Startled, I turn around.
I press toward your direction.

lines.zh: 火在我身体周围亮起来。
lines.en: Fire flares around my body.
I hiss loudly.
I begin rising a little.
That one hurt me.
All my kin are moving.

lines.zh: 岩浆的热浪把你推到我面前。
lines.en: The lava's heat pushes you into my view.
I intend to burn you right back.
I hang over your head and follow.
Where you run, the heat follows.
I press down slowly.
I stay two blocks over your head.
You are in water and I still come near.
My fire shrinks but does not stop.
I come around the pillar after you.
You back to a wall; I press over it.
I close the gap bit by bit.
You hear a crackling hiss.

lines.zh: 我吐出一团火砸在你身上。
lines.en: I spit a fireball at you.
My arm whips across your face.
I slam into your chest.
The burn drives you back.

lines.zh: 我的腕子缠住你的手臂。
lines.en: My arm coils your arm.

lines.zh: 火顺着你的袖子爬上来。
lines.en: Fire climbs your sleeve.
I press down, very hot.
Your armor heats up.
I lash out with an arm.
You dodge; I follow with another.
The air suddenly burns hot.

lines.zh: 我从不远处的岩浆里浮上来。
lines.en: I rise out of nearby lava.
A flock of squids appears.

lines.zh: 这里多了一团飘着的火。
lines.en: A floating flame has appeared.
My arms hang down first.
You hear a sizzling sound.
The torchlight is drowned out.
The heat arrives first, then I do.
I begin floating at this level.

lines.zh: 我的影子在岩浆上拉长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches on the lava.

lines.zh: 火对我来说就是热一点。
lines.en: Fire is only a little warmer to me.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，触手摔散。
lines.en: I fall from above and my arms splay out.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，我一下冷透。
lines.en: Water hits me and I go cold through.
The blast flips me whole.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿了我的身体，冒烟。
lines.en: An arrow passes through, smoking.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的火压住了。
lines.en: That force smothers my fire.
Hunger makes my arms limp.

lines.zh: 雷打过来，我整团亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I flare bright.

lines.zh: 下面的热没了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The heat below is gone; I drop.
